title: Certified Vote Totals, Statewide and by County, for 1998 Proposition No. 4 (Series 21817?) (Utah State Elections, Office Of The Lieutenant Governor)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Government Records Access and Management Act, I hereby request the following records:

Subject: GRAMA Request: Certified Vote Totals, Statewide and by County, for 1998 Proposition No. 4 (Series 21817?)

Pursuant to the Government Records Access and Management Act (GRAMA), I hereby request the following records:

- The certified statewide vote totals (raw number of ballots cast "for" and "against," not percentages) for Proposition No. 4, "Resolution Eliminating Voting Rights of Convicted Felons" (H.J.R. 4), as it appeared on the November 3, 1998 Utah general election ballot.

- The certified county-level vote totals (raw ballot counts, not percentages) for the same measure, for each of Utah's 29 counties.

I believe this data may be held within Series 21817, "State and county election returns from the Lieutenant Governor," or a related series covering the 1998 general election. If this record is held elsewhere, or under a different series, I would appreciate being redirected accordingly.

If any of the requested records are exempt from disclosure, please cite the specific statutory exemption and release all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions. If fees for locating, reviewing, or duplicating these records are expected to exceed a nominal amount ($20.00), please contact me with an estimate before proceeding.

I would appreciate a response within the timeframe required under GRAMA. Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,

Michael Owens

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Michael Owens

title: Intoxalock Ignition Interlock, 831 Washington St — Storage Tank and Hazardous Materials Records

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Public Records Law, I am requesting the following records from the Hanover Fire Department concerning Intoxalock Ignition Interlock, located at 831 Washington St, Hanover, MA 02339:
1.	Underground Storage Tank (UST) and Aboveground Storage Tank (AST) permits and associated permit files.
2.	Flammable material storage licenses and associated licensing records.
3.	Hazardous materials incident reports and spill reports for the property.

Please search using both the facility name and address, including responsive historical records maintained under former business or operator names at this address.



I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as we believe this request is in the public interest, as suggested but not stipulated by the recommendations of the Massachusetts Supervisor of Public Records. The requested documents will be made available to the general public free of charge as part of the public information service at MuckRock.com, and is not made for commercial usage.

I expect the request to be filled in an accessible format, including for screen readers, which provide text-to-speech for persons unable to read print. Files that are not accessible to screen readers include, for example, .pdf image files as well as physical documents.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

{ Vlad Gaylun }
